S7-1515F-2PN.note: Case A CPU: X1 PROFINET IO controller, X2 Ethernet (no IO-controller use in this design)

AS332P.note: Delta AS300 class: 1 Ethernet (Modbus TCP / EtherNet/IP), 2 x RS-485 built in [verify]

CP1543-1.note: communication processor Gigabit Ethernet, stateful firewall, VPN, separate IP subnet; MB_SERVER over the CP (InterfaceId = CP hardware id) [verify]

CM1542-1.note: communication module, additional PROFINET IO controller (2 ports) [verify]

CM_PtP_RS485_HF.note: CM PtP RS422/485 HF: Modbus RTU master with Modbus_Comm_Load / Modbus_Master, up to 115.2 kbit/s [verify]

AS-FEN02.note: Delta AS function card, 2nd Ethernet interface (Modbus TCP) [verify]

AS-FCOPM.note: Delta AS function card CANopen master [verify]

AS00SCM-A.note: Delta AS serial communication module with one RS-485 function card (Modbus RTU master) [verify]

EXT-FW.note: external industrial firewall / router between the machine zone and VLAN 720 (when no CP with firewall exists for the PLC family)

PS60W.note: system power supply PS 60 W 24/48/60 V DC in slot 0: needed when the CPU's backplane feed is not enough for the modules [verify]

A.desc: Case A (built-in ports, as Part B/C): factory Modbus TCP on X2, one PROFINET IO network on X1, scale via AI module, no serial devices, zone boundary only at the L3 firewall

B1.desc: Case B1 (Siemens + expansion modules): factory link on a separate CP with firewall (IEC 62443 conduit at the machine), X2 kept for HMI/engineering inside the machine zone, 2nd PROFINET IO network for the F4 conveyors, RS-485 Modbus RTU line for energy meter + weighing terminal + 24 V UPS

B2.desc: Case B2 (Delta AS + expansion): crane PLC rides on the crane; factory Modbus TCP via the data light barrier on the CPU port, 2nd Ethernet card for ground remote I/O (conveyors), CANopen for the 3 crane drives, RS-485 Modbus RTU line (built in) for the energy meter + weighing terminal + UPS; external firewall for the zone boundary

rtu._note: RS-485 Modbus RTU line 1 in the ground cabinet +GC; 8E1 (11 bit per character). Slave response times = reference estimates from typical data sheets [verify per device].

slaves.name: weighing terminal infeed scale (replaces the AI module -KF27)

tcp._note: end-to-end latency of a WMS command; reference estimates

profinet._note: cyclic frames per IO device and direction; 100 Mbit/s; frame = max(64, 26 + payload) bytes on the wire + 20 byte preamble/IFG; planning limit 50 % cyclic load [verify vs. the PI installation guideline]

canopen._note: Case B2 crane drives; CiA 301 bit-rate / length table (typical values); 8-byte PDO = 111 bit + worst-case stuffing 24 bit
